dispatcher_source_trace.test_cleanup: agentplane/system_tests/test_dispatcher.py:_cleanup_sandbox (lines 114-139) patches running=false; waits for Suspended and then Ready reason Stopped; on timeout it captures diagnostics and re-raises.
dispatcher_source_trace.latched_journal_error: agentplane/runner/journal.go:369-376 checkWritableLocked returns ErrJournalFailed after j.failure is set; Journal.write/WithBatch set failure on canceled transaction/commit/callback paths at lines 507-578.
dispatcher_source_trace.session_teardown: agentplane/runner/session_controller.go:182-255 advances halt, stop, and seal; runner_controller.go:82-109,155-206 waits for sessions halted/stopped, seals, then exact sealed ingress acknowledgements before Quiesced.
dispatcher_source_trace.runtime_correlation: the PendingCommand Lease blocker session ID equals the session-lifecycle and ingress session ID whose journal reports context canceled; runner-gateway holds the Lease at quiesce-stage=draining while the Sandbox is Suspended but Ready=False/Quiescing.
dispatcher_source_trace.limit: No retained journal database or original canceled transaction operation; previous-container log request returned "previous terminated container ... not found". This proves where quiesce stalls and the latched error, but not which original write operation or context owner produced cancellation.
